review.title: Add internal Accessibility selector engine
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: Exact 1e56b00...f19cbd9 five-commit remediation delta and all 12 changed paths
PRR-021, PRR-022, PRR-025, and PRR-026 current-head revalidation
Generated producer through client normalization, protocol observation, and WeChat recovery
Every shared fallback caller and expected-action source
Malformed, missing, duplicate, contradictory, request-mismatched, unsupported, pre-dispatch, timeout, and transport-loss evidence
Root/package tests, stress, compile, release preflight, wheel/install/API smoke, dependency rejection, clean tree, and exact-head CI
excluded_scope: Fresh real WeChat or macOS Accessibility mutation
Signed or notarized helper execution and TestPyPI or PyPI publication
Unrelated dirty primary-worktree files and private desktop observations
Repository-wide strict-mypy cleanup outside this remediation

delta_review.summary: The delta records the request-changes review, amends the contract and plan, fixes producer/normalizer/consumer behavior, adds production-derived and adversarial tests, and publishes exact-implementation verification.
delta_review.evidence: git log, name-status diff, full affected-path audit, prior finding ledger, clean-clone tests, wheel checks, and exact-head GitHub CI

finding_revalidation.evidence: Four-state attempted/dispatch evidence rejects malformed containers, non-Boolean values, and conflicting aliases; client normalization no longer coerces; operation-count tests execute zero unsafe fallback.
The production-generated native failure carries the requested action through ComputerUseClient and both valid native pairs use exactly one configured WeChat fallback.
ACCESSIBILITY_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED remains in COMPUTER_USE_FAILURE_KINDS and package/root/wheel checks pass.
Every recovery caller passes its outbound expected action; both internally valid request/response mismatch directions stop after accessibility_action.

forward_risk_review.reason: Adding action to post-call failures must match the actual request and survive normalization and packaging.
checks: Production generated worker exercises AXPress/-25206 and AXSetFocus/-25205
ComputerUseClient and protocol observation preserve action
Wheel build, install, import, and API smoke pass

forward_risk_review.surface: Attempted and dispatch evidence trust boundary
forward_risk_review.reason: Malformed or conflicting evidence must not be mistaken for safe absence or false.
checks: Truthy and falsey non-Boolean attempted values
Malformed action, metadata, diagnostics, and transport containers

forward_risk_review.reason: An internally valid proof for another action must not authorize fallback for the requested action.
checks: Audit every shared fallback call site

forward_risk_review.surface: Feature contract, review history, and verification publication

forward_risk_review.reason: Test stubs must execute production code without leaking into distributable artifacts.

independent_pass.summary: Independent agents were unavailable; a separate source/caller audit and clean-clone exact-head run rechecked producer propagation, malformed evidence, both mismatch directions, operation counts, and induced test-harness risk without finding a blocker.

decision.rationale: PRR-021, PRR-022, PRR-025, and PRR-026 are resolved at f19cbd9. Production-generated valid native pairs retain one fallback, malformed or mismatched evidence authorizes none, every delta change is classified, broad local validation passes, and exact-head GitHub CI is green.

summary: The remediation closes all prior blockers by carrying the real requested action from the generated native producer, avoiding Boolean coercion, parsing attempted and dispatch evidence presence-sensitively, and binding strict proof to the outbound action. No new blocker was found.

findings.title: Malformed attempt or dispatch evidence could replay an action
findings.observation: Attempted and dispatch evidence now has explicit presence, validity, and Boolean value; malformed or contradictory evidence fails closed, and client normalization does not coerce it.
findings.trigger: A compatible or malformed backend publishes a non-Boolean attempted value, malformed relevant container, or conflicting dispatch alias.
findings.impact: The shared recovery gate no longer authorizes a second desktop mutation when the first action outcome is uncertain.

evidence.description: Malformed attempted and dispatch cases assert exactly one accessibility_action and zero fallback.
Client normalization preserves malformed raw attempt values without trusted promotion.

findings.remediation: Completed: use presence-sensitive evidence objects, validate all relevant containers and aliases, and remove truthiness coercion.
findings.verification: Package suites, ten-iteration stress, and exact-head focused tests pass with operation-count assertions.

findings.title: The real native unsupported producer omitted action
findings.observation: Generated post-call failures now include the validated requested action and retain it through ComputerUseClient normalization.
findings.trigger: AXPress returns -25206 or AXSetFocus returns -25205 on the real direct backend.
findings.impact: Both legitimate native unsupported cases can use exactly one configured compatibility fallback.

evidence.description: Production warm-worker script tests exercise both native pairs through ComputerUseClient and WeChat.

findings.remediation: Completed: pass action into generated unsupported and uncertain post-call failure payloads and preserve the raw result.
findings.verification: Both production-generated pairs carry the matching action and execute one fallback; wheel/API smoke passes.

findings.impact: A mismatched proof can no longer authorize a second mutation after an unknown requested-action outcome.

evidence.description: Both AXPress-to-AXSetFocus and AXSetFocus-to-AXPress mismatch directions execute zero fallback.

findings.remediation: Completed: require expected_action at every shared recovery call and compare it in the strict proof.
findings.verification: Both mismatch directions stop after accessibility_action; matching production pairs retain one fallback.
